brief: How can I make a technically defensible case to my boss for delaying the app update, while testing whether a full delay is necessary?

methods.text: Does anyone's figure change the answer?
What should we find out first?
What would have to be true?
Are we asking the right question?
Which way does each option push our aims?
How do similar situations turn out?
How much rests on Olumi's guesses?
Is a bias at work here?
